title: QuantumTransportEOM: symbolic equation-of-motion Green functions and fast numerical quantum transport
description: Python package coupling a SymPy-based second-quantization layer (commutators, equation-of-motion closure, mean-field truncations, Keldysh contour algebra, exact CAR engine) to a NumPy transport engine (Landauer, Meir-Wingreen, spin-resolved observables) with batched linear algebra, multi-core frequency sweeps, and optional CUDA GPU execution via CuPy. Includes custom-model support for arbitrary fermionic/bosonic Hamiltonians, voltage-probe and dephasing-probe solvers, and the full reproduction package (models, solvers, data, and figure scripts) for the CISS voltage-probe study of chirality-induced spin selectivity in rho-tau-sigma ladder models.
